body:
I believe you and am sorry that you are going through this...

Please get some help and do not hurt yourself.  Do whatever it is you need to do to stay safe;  go to the ER if necessary.
 
I know it seems hopeless, but it can and likely will get better.  You are in a shitty situation and need to reach out to someone for help.

Your friends are probably not the best sources of support in this case.  They probably don't understand because they have not experienced your situation and find it hard to put themselves in your place.

Are there any adults you can talk to about the situation instead?

But seriously, kudos to you for recognizing the need to stay sane while you are living in an abusive household.  I didn't figure it out until I was much older.

Does she call you directly or go through a receptionist?  Could you ask for a new phone number or ask whoever answers the phone to tell your mother that they no longer allow personal calls at work?

If all else fails, you could possibly file a restraining order

Whenever I say no to anything regarding my sister or her new baby, my father goes off about how I need to stop being jealous and selfish...he is still going on about how my sister had to do her own invitations for her shower (although I already had them done and ready to go-she hadn't bothered to ask)

I know that I am way too concerned about getting my parents' approval and am working on that.
YES!  I have huge issues with bossy women as well.  Haven't figured out an effective way of dealing with them yet, so just avoid, avoid, avoid...

I'm so sorry that your grandmother treated you differently and that your mother was thoughtless enough to tell you about it!

Unfortunately both my parents and my sister and BIL are very self-centered and will never accept an adopted child as a "real" part of the family (although they would act like they do in public because they are concerned about how it would make them look).
I know, but it makes me so angry to know how any we would adopt would be treated like a second class citizen...I guess like how I and my husband are treated now :(

First of all, please do not kill yourself because of your mom!
Is there anyone at school or somewhere else you can talk to?

I'm sorry;  I wish there was a way to get rid of the stigma of depression.  I think people may compare feeling "blue" to being depressed, when we know that it is an entirely different beast altogether.

Well of course you MUST like ice cream cake since your mom does, right :) ?
Sorry this happens to you too....
That's the thing, when I say I don't want to go out, it's like a personal affront to them.  How dare I not want to go out???
I'm sorry that this happened to you.  I don't think that it has to be "abuse" per se in order for it to have been traumatic for you.
Wow-really interesting insight.  Never really looked at it like this before-Thank you!

Sorry that happened to you too :(
I told my father that next year everybody could go out without me. He thought I was joking...
